name: Winners List of Texas Lottery® Prizes
attribution: IT Lottery & Charitable Bingo, Texas Department of Licensing & Regulation
description:
List of winner claims for Texas Lottery® prizes with player (excluding identity of those designated anonymous), prize, game and selling retailer information.
GOV'T § 466.411: A prize winner, or owner of a legal entity that is a prize winner, of a lottery prize in an amount equal to $1 million or more may choose to remain anonymous.  If the prize is an annuity, then the prize winner may be anonymous for 30 days after the prize is claimed.

columns.name: Row ID
columns.description: Unique key.

columns.name: Claim Number
columns.description: A number assigned by the Claims Process.  A claim may contain multiple claim lines.

columns.name: Amount Won
columns.description: Amount won for winning play if cash prize.  Prize value for 2nd Chance promotion if merchandise prize.

columns.name: Date Claim Paid
columns.description: The date the claim was paid.

columns.name: Player ID
columns.description: Number assigned by the payment processing system to the claimant, or claim number for anonymous claimant.

columns.name: Annuity Indicator
columns.description: Indicator if the claim is an annuity (YES) or cash value option (NO).

columns.name: Anonymous Indicator
columns.description: Indicator of player's request to remain anonymous.

columns.name: Claim Center Location
columns.description: Name of lottery claim center office that processed the claim.

columns.name: Claim Type
columns.description: Indicator if the claim was claimed as an individual or legal entity.

columns.name: US Citizen Flag
columns.description: Indicator if claimant is US Citizen (YES/NO) or not provided.

columns.name: Last Name
columns.description: The last name of individual claimant or the full entity name if an entity.  If anonymity requested, anonymous will be displayed for individuals.

columns.name: First Name
columns.description: The first name of the claimant.  If anonymity requested, anonymous will be displayed for individuals.

columns.name: Claimant Name and Player ID
columns.description: The last name, first name and player id for individuals or the full entity name and player id if an entity.  If anonymity requested, anonymous will be displayed along with claim number for individuals.

columns.name: Claimant City
columns.description: The city where the claimant resides.

columns.name: Claimant State
columns.description: The state where the claimant resides.

columns.name: Claimant County
columns.description: The county where the claimant resides.

columns.name: Claimant Country
columns.description: The country where the claimant resides.

columns.name: Prize or Merchandise Indicator
columns.description: Indicator if claim is prize (money) or merchandise.

columns.name: Scratch Ticket or Draw Game
columns.description: The lottery game category of the ticket.  Draw Game or Scratch Ticket.

columns.name: Date of Draw
columns.description: The date the draw game drawing occurred.

columns.name: Draw Time of Day
columns.description: The time of the day the draw occurred: Morning, Day, Evening or Night.

columns.name: Prize Level
columns.description: Describes the prize level of the winning play for Draw Games only.

columns.name: Date Ticket Sold
columns.description: The date the draw game ticket was sold.

columns.name: Scratch Ticket Game Number
columns.description: The game number of the scratch ticket.

columns.name: Scratch Ticket Cost
columns.description: The cost per scratch ticket dollar amount.

columns.name: Retailer Number
columns.description: The retailer number that sold the ticket.

columns.name: Retailer Name
columns.description: The retailer name that sold the ticket.

columns.name: Retailer Number and Name
columns.description: The retailer number/name that sold the ticket.

columns.name: Retailer Address 1
columns.description: The address line 1 of the retailer that sold the ticket.

columns.name: Retailer Address 2
columns.description: The address line 2 of the retailer that sold the ticket.

columns.name: Retailer City
columns.description: The city of the retailer that sold the ticket.

columns.name: Retailer State
columns.description: The state of the retailer that sold the ticket.

columns.name: Retailer Zip Code
columns.description: The zip code of the retailer that sold the ticket.

columns.name: Retailer Zip Code +4
columns.description: The zip code+4 of the retailer that sold the ticket.

columns.name: Retailer County
columns.description: The county of the retailer that sold the ticket.
